notes:
A compound of ⟦{識別|しきべつ}→識別：06785_shikibetsu⟧ (identification, discrimination) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Refers to the capacity to perceive differences between similar things, whether sensory (colors, sounds, tastes), intellectual (quality judgments), or technological (pattern recognition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have high discernment
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: to cultivate discernment
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{識別力|しきべつりょく}: color discrimination ability
- {識別力|しきべつりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in discernment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{判断力|はんだんりょく}→判断力：17617_handanryoku⟧: judgment, decision-making ability (broader; about making good decisions, not just perceiving differences)
- {鑑識力|かんしきりょく}: connoisseurship, expert appraisal ability (implies trained expertise in evaluating quality)
- ⟦{洞察力|どうさつりょく}→洞察力：08523_dousatsuryoku⟧: insight, perceptiveness (ability to see hidden truths, not just surface differences)
